description: On desktop, Studio's own window may read quick ask's keys and whether they work through plugin:quick-ask|shortcut, and change them through plugin:quick-ask|shortcut_set, from Settings › Shortcuts (HAL-18787). The command registers only the keys it is given, as quick ask's one shortcut, and lets go of the old ones; no page can listen to keys. It is local only, so the Studio the computer serves gets nothing.
